name: Inbox
description: Questions and plans from Claude Code agents, answered when you have time while the agent keeps working.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Open threads in the Inbox panel (right sidebar)

settings.title: Send Claude Code questions to the Inbox
settings.description: AskUserQuestion calls become Inbox threads; the agent keeps working and gets your answer as its next message.

settings.title: Send Claude Code plans to the Inbox
settings.description: ExitPlanMode calls become Inbox threads to approve or send back with feedback.

settings.title: Open a thread when an agent is blocked
settings.description: A thread appears while an agent waits for you in its terminal (a permission prompt, say) and closes when it works again.
